lines.label: B1
lines.reason: The 90.7 deg fold between plate (2) and flange (3) is real. The line is parallel and sits on the outer apex in the 25/50/75% sections: nearest outer-skin point 0.16, 0.10 and 0.04 mm, with the inner skin about 1.47 mm along the bisector. It runs from relief notch to relief notch and covers about 99% of the visible fold, overhanging each end by at most about 1 mm.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: The 44.4 deg fold from flange (4) to the +x tab (6) is real. The line is on the outer apex in all three sections (0.13, 0.03 and 0.01 mm). It spans the full 17.6 mm of the fold, from the flange free edge to the relief notch next to the plate. The tab hole is not near the line.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: The 44.2 deg fold from flange (4) to the -x tab (7) is real. The line is on the outer apex in all three sections (0.03, 0.14 and 0.18 mm). It spans the full 17.6 mm of the fold, from the free edge to the relief notch, and is parallel to the fold.
